items.question: Do the further audit procedures performed respond to each assessed risk of material misstatement, and are the responses documented against the risk register?
Have journal entries and other adjustments been tested for management override, including unusual entries near period end?
Have trade receivable balances been tested by confirmation or alternative procedures, with cut-off and recoverability assessed?
Have trade payable and accrual balances been tested for completeness and cut-off, including a search for unrecorded liabilities?
Have bank balances been agreed to bank confirmations and reconciliations, and have reconciling items been followed up?
Have payroll costs, statutory deductions (PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, housing levy) and related liabilities been tested?
Have revenue transactions been tested for occurrence, accuracy and cut-off, in response to the presumed fraud risk?
Have additions, disposals and depreciation of property, plant and equipment been tested?
Have accounting estimates and the related disclosures been evaluated, including indicators of management bias?
Have identified related party transactions and balances been tested and their disclosure agreed to evidence?
Have inquiries and procedures on compliance with laws and regulations been performed, and any non-compliance evaluated and communicated?
Have misstatements been accumulated on the schedule of adjustments, with unadjusted items evaluated against materiality?
Have control deficiencies identified during the audit been recorded and assessed for communication to management?
Have the additional unpredictable procedures planned for the elevated fraud risk been performed and the results evaluated?
Given the going concern indicators, has management's forecast been tested, and has the adequacy of the related disclosure been assessed?
